//: Every external dependency, why we have it and which packages may use it (plan 7.1). Adding one needs Liam's approval. allowedIn takes package names; * matches any text.

@biomejs/biome.reason: Formatter and linter in one fast tool.

@noble/hashes.reason: scrypt password hashing: independently audited, no dependencies, runs on every runtime. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2, 11). Only the package that implements the PasswordHasher port uses it.
@noble/hashes.useInstead: the PasswordHasher port; for SHA-256 use the hashing port (WebCrypto)

@types/node.reason: Type definitions for Node, for Node packages, tests and tooling. The core's tsconfig loads no Node types.

@typescript/typescript6.reason: The TypeScript parser API for tooling/check until TypeScript 7.1 ships its own API (D9). Remove then.

react-data-grid.reason: The table editor: cell editing, keyboard navigation and screen-reader support. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2).

remark.reason: Parses Markdown, including model output, into a tree; our own view renders it without raw HTML. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2).

remark-gfm.reason: Tables, task lists, strikethrough and autolinks for remark. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2).

turbo.reason: Per-package tasks, --affected and the build cache (D9).

yaml.reason: Reads and writes YAML; the same library as the old app, so saved files come out the same. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2). No dependencies.

zod.reason: Validation and JSON Schema output. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10, plan v1.11, 7.2). No dependencies. Wrapped by schema-kit, so the rest of the code never sees Zod.
